app_fee.value: Application fee is $90 for School of Arts and Sciences PhD programs.
app_fee.quote: Application fee payment ($90) or approval of Application Fee Waiver Request

fee_waiver.value: A limited number of waivers go to PhD applicants showing clear and compelling financial hardship; international eligibility is not addressed. Request inside the finalized application at least 2 weeks before the Dec 8 deadline.
fee_waiver.quote: A limited number of application fee waivers are available for Ph.D. applicants who demonstrate clear and compelling financial hardship.

also.quote: please finalize your application and submit your waiver request at least 2 weeks prior to the application deadline

gre_general.value: Set by each graduate group; see the program records.
gre_general.quote: GRE, where required. Check your graduate group for details on program requirements.

toefl_min.value: The Graduate Division gives no minimum score; each graduate group sets its own.

ielts_min.value: The Graduate Division gives no minimum score; each graduate group sets its own.

english_waiver.value: Applicants whose native language is not English need TOEFL/IELTS, but some programs waive it if the whole post-secondary degree was taught in English; ask the program and upload a transcript.
english_waiver.quote: Certain programs may waive this requirement if your post-secondary degree was conducted entirely in English.

notes: Penn has no single graduate school; this record uses the School of Arts and Sciences Graduate Division (physics, chemistry, math, biology, earth and environmental science). Penn Engineering (fee $95 per search snippet only) and Perelman School of Medicine pages were blocked (HTTP 502), so no engineering or biomedical program records were saved.
